name: substack-login
description: Make sure Chrome is signed in to Substack as Mike's writer account, @rsilt: the account that owns aiwtf.substack.com and his other publications. If it already is, the run exits at s03. Otherwise the sign_in branch asks Substack to email a sign-in link to {{email}}, opens the newest Substack email in Gmail (Mike's signed-in Google account) and clicks its sign-in button. On either path, the proof is Substack's own profile JSON naming the handle rsilt.
requires: Run from scripts/substack.mjs, which opens a Substack tab. No password is typed at any point.
authorship: v1 2026-09-13 (fleet recipe set). v2: Mike Wolf (direction); Claude Opus 5 (CCc), 2026-09-15.
anomalies: v1 went green at its assess_state step whether or not the session was signed in. An assess_state step with no `expect` always counts as matched, so its onMatch exit_success always fired. v2 sets expect.

v1 took any page under substack.com/publish as proof of sign-in, whichever account was signed in. @rsilt administers 11 publications (2026-09-15). v2 checks the handle in https://substack.com/api/v1/user/profile/self.
assess_state does not interpolate {{params}}, so s03 carries the handle rsilt literally.

Substack's web sign-in takes an email address and sends a one-time sign-in link; it also offers 'Sign in with password'. This recipe never uses a password. The link arrives in Mike's Google mailbox, which is the Google half of the flow.

The sign_in branch was written on 2026-09-15 without being exercised: while signed in, substack.com/sign-in redirects to the home feed, so the signed-out page could not be inspected. Heal the b-steps on the first signed-out run.

chain.message: This run landed on a tab that is not on substack.com. Open a Substack tab first (scripts/substack.mjs does) and pass its tab id; refusing to navigate whatever tab is active.

chain.note: Signed in as @rsilt: done, and this match is the proof. Otherwise run the sign_in branch, then the proof below.

chain.message: Still not signed in as @rsilt after the sign-in branch.

steps.note: If this times out while a different account is signed in, sign that account out first.
Substack says it sent the sign-in link (v1's state graph recorded this text).
The newest Substack email; Gmail's search updates as mail arrives.
A real click. Gmail opens the link in a new tab, and the sign-in cookie it sets is shared by every tab.
